name: Hand Layup Task State
description: State variables the intent monitor LLM must track from video frames

current_phase.description: Current high-level phase of the task

current_action.description: Specific action currently being performed (must match a DAG node name)

human_state.description: Current activity of the human operator

layers_placed.description: Number of fiberglass layers placed on the mold (0-4)

layers_resined.description: Number of layers that have had resin applied (0-4)

resin_added.description: Whether resin has been added to the cup

hardener_added.description: Whether hardener has been added to the cup

mixture_mixed.description: Whether the mixture has been properly mixed

consolidated.description: Whether roller consolidation has been performed

human_wearing_gloves.description: Whether the human operator is wearing protective gloves

predicted_next_action.description: Predicted next action based on task graph

prediction_confidence.description: Confidence in the predicted next action (0-1)

robot_state.description: Robot execution status for decision context

robot_active_program.description: Current robot program/action id when busy
